name: Legal
declaration: Inborn runs a language model on this device. Nothing you type or paste leaves it, and there is no account or server. The model can be wrong, can invent citations and can miss a controlling authority: every output is a draft for a lawyer to verify, not legal advice and not a substitute for research. Using this tool does not create a privilege or any protection beyond what your own conduct and this device's security provide; check your bar's rules on AI assistance and client confidentiality before relying on it. Client vaults, the audit log and signed exports document what happened on this device; they do not certify anything to a court.
